settings.title: Settings
settings.pendingHint: Leave empty until MSI confirms it. Empty fields print blank on documents.

validation.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 2,000.00.
validation.code: Use 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter, for example BR4.
validation.branchRequired: Cashiers and loan officers need a branch.
validation.days: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 60.

company.heading: Company header
company.intro: Shown on every screen, receipt and document.
company.name: Company name
company.logoIntro: Always shown on a white tile. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
company.templatesIntro: Placeholders in braces are filled in for each loan: {placeholders}.
company.reminder: Reminder before or on the due date

branches.heading: Branches
branches.intro: The branch code appears in loan, receipt and expense numbers and cannot change later.
branches.name: Name
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add the first branch to start.

rules.heading: Rule settings
rules.intro: Defaults from the assumption register. Each value is waiting for MSI sign-off (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md).
rules.loanManagerLimit: Largest loan a manager may approve (A-07)
rules.loanManagerLimitHelp: Above this amount the CEO must approve.
rules.expenseLimit: Expenses recorded without manager approval, up to (A-20)
rules.collateralRequired: Collateral is required for every loan (A-10)
rules.multiLoan: One collateral item may secure more than one active loan (A-10)
rules.requireRemittance: Field collections must be handed over to a cashier (A-12)
rules.checkFunds: Check the cash balance before paying out a loan
rules.allocationIntro: Each payment pays these parts in this order.
rules.goLiveHelp: Before this date the accountant and admin may enter back-dated records. Leave empty until it is agreed.
rules.clockIntro: Moves the system date for demonstrations. Production always uses the real date.
rules.clockFrozen: Keep the clock stopped at this time
rules.dueUpcomingDaysHelp: How far ahead the due list shows loans that fall due soon.

users.heading: Users
users.intro: Only the administrator creates accounts. Staff cannot sign themselves up.
users.name: Full name
users.resetConfirm: Reset the password for {name}? Their current password stops working at once.
users.passwordIntro: Give this password to {name} in person. It is shown only once and is not stored anywhere you can see it again.
users.selfNote: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.

products.heading: Loan products
products.intro: Interest, term and penalty rules offered to borrowers. A loan copies its product's rules when it is submitted, so changes here apply only to new loans.
products.name: Product
products.snapshotNote: Interest is flat: principal × rate × months, charged at payout. Existing loans keep the rules they were approved with.

validation.percent: Enter a percentage with at most two decimals (for example 20 or 12.5).
validation.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number in the allowed range.
validation.termOrder: The usual term cannot be longer than the longest term.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change in the system, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.intro: Every money movement is a balanced journal. Posted journals cannot be changed; mistakes are corrected with a reversing journal.
ledger.empty: No journals match these filters. Journals appear here as loans are paid out, payments come in and expenses are paid.

trial.heading: Trial balance as at {date}
trial.balanced: Balanced: total debits equal total credits.
trial.unbalanced: Not balanced: total debits and credits differ by {difference}. Tell the accountant and Corex support straight away.
trial.empty: No entries up to this date.

manual.heading: Request a manual journal
manual.intro: For corrections and entries that no other screen records. A manager approves it before it is posted. Every manual journal needs a memo explaining why.
manual.sent: Sent for approval. A manager will review it.
manual.lineError: Enter an amount in either the debit or the credit column, not both.
manual.minLines: A journal needs at least two lines.
manual.mineEmpty: You have not requested any manual journals or capital entries yet.

capital.heading: Record owner capital
capital.intro: Money the owners put into the business (recipe R10: the account is debited, Owner's Capital is credited). A manager approves it before it is posted.

customers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No customers} one {# customer} other {# customers}}

approvals.writeOffOverride: No recovery case has reached disposal; the manager gave the reason above. Approving moves {amount} to bad debts and closes the loan.
approvals.dayLockNote: Approving locks this day for the branch; nothing more can be posted to it unless it is reopened.

guarantors.heading: Guarantors (optional)
guarantors.intro: Up to 3 people who promise to pay if the borrower cannot. Their ID scan is added with the loan documents.

validation.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 1000 or 1,000.00.

wizard.title: New loan
wizard.intro: Five short steps. Nothing is saved until you send the application; a manager (or the CEO above the limit) approves it before the cashier pays out.
wizard.noProducts: No loan product is offered. Ask the administrator to add one under Settings, Loan products.
wizard.searchHelp: Type at least 2 letters or digits of the name, phone, ID number or code.
wizard.noMatches: No active customer matches. Register the customer first.
